description: This file defines the 'Database' class used for handling database backup operations within the vtiger CRM system. It manages database connection setup, backup procedures, and error handling specific to MySQL databases.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: A class for managing database backup operations, including connection setup, backup initiation, and error handling for MySQL databases.

methods.name: getCreateTarget
methods.description: Returns whether the database target should be created during backup.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Checks if the database configuration matches a specified type.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the database connection, optionally creating a new database if specified.

methods.name: startBackup
methods.description: Initializes the backup process, setting necessary database parameters.

methods.name: startTableBackup
methods.description: Placeholder for starting table backup; currently does nothing.

methods.name: processTableCreateStatement
methods.description: Processes a table creation statement during backup.

methods.name: processStatement
methods.description: Executes a given SQL statement on the database connection.

methods.name: finishTableBackup
methods.description: Placeholder for finishing table backup; currently does nothing.

methods.name: checkError
methods.description: Checks for errors after executing SQL statements and throws exceptions if needed.

methods.name: isUTF8SupportEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether UTF8 support is enabled for the database connection.
